sloka: विभीषणमिमं सौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय ।अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च मम चैवोपकारिणम् ।। ६.११५.९ ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇamimaṁ saumya laṅkāyāmabhiṣecaya ।anuraktaṁ ca bhaktaṁ ca mama caivopakāriṇam ।। 6.115.9 ।।

translations.english: "Gentle Lakshmana! Vibheeshana is friendly to me and devoted. He has done me good work in the past. Consecrate him in Lanka."
